parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    -- Шаг 1: Принимаем входящие данные от n8n
    SELECT 
        $1::text AS sender_identifier, 
        $2::text AS channel 
),
employee_search AS (
    -- Шаг 2: Ищем в сотрудниках (team_directory)
    SELECT 
        'employee'::text AS user_type,
        full_name::text AS name,
        user_role::text AS role_or_niche,
        NULL::text AS crm_deal_id,
        NULL::text AS client_status,
        dify_conversation_id::text AS dify_conversation_id, 
        NULL::text AS active_ticket_id
    FROM team_directory, input
    WHERE input.sender_identifier != 'unknown' -- 🛡️ ЗАЩИТА ОТ ЗАГЛУШЕК
      AND (
        (input.channel = 'telegram' AND team_directory.telegram_id::text = input.sender_identifier)
        OR 
        (input.channel = 'email' AND team_directory.email = input.sender_identifier)
      )
    LIMIT 1
),
client_search AS (
    -- Шаг 3: Ищем в клиентах (leads_pipeline)
    SELECT 
        'client'::text AS user_type,
        'Client'::text AS name, 
        company_niche::text AS role_or_niche,
        crm_deal_id::text AS crm_deal_id,
        client_status::text AS client_status,
        conversation_id::text AS dify_conversation_id
    FROM leads_pipeline, input
    WHERE input.sender_identifier != 'unknown' -- 🛡️ ЗАЩИТА ОТ ЗАГЛУШЕК
      AND leads_pipeline.contact_id = input.sender_identifier
    LIMIT 1
),
active_ticket AS (
    -- Шаг 4: Ищем открытые тикеты для клиента (support_tickets)
    SELECT ticket_id::text AS ticket_id
    FROM support_tickets, input
    WHERE input.sender_identifier != 'unknown' -- 🛡️ ЗАЩИТА ОТ ЗАГЛУШЕК
      AND support_tickets.contact_id = input.sender_identifier
      AND status != 'closed' 
    LIMIT 1
),
combined_client_data AS (
    -- Шаг 5: Склеиваем клиента с его тикетом
    SELECT 
        c.user_type, c.name, c.role_or_niche, c.crm_deal_id, c.client_status, c.dify_conversation_id,
        t.ticket_id AS active_ticket_id
    FROM client_search c
    LEFT JOIN active_ticket t ON true
)
-- Шаг 6: Выводим результат
SELECT * FROM employee_search
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM combined_client_data
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO tg_album_files (media_group_id, base64_data, caption) 
VALUES ($1, $2, $3);

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO tg_album_locks (media_group_id)
    VALUES ($1)
    ON CONFLICT (media_group_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING media_group_id
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) THEN 'LEADER'
        ELSE 'FOLLOWER'
    END as role;
